title: 第5章 刘宇宁
novel_title: 丰腴小村妇，大佬们跪求嫁给他(锦绣钱澄)
content_zh: 徐喜弟又起晚了。身子没有那么酸疼，就是纯睡得太香。范金花也没叫她，在堂屋嚓嚓剁猪菜。猪菜！徐喜弟瞬间惊坐起，她还要去割猪菜！时间都快中午了吧，外边太阳都已经热起来了。穿好衣服急匆匆出房门，就看到堂屋放猪菜的墙角，放着一大筐猪菜，旁边还有满满一麻袋，被硬挤硬塞快爆开了。范金花已经剁了满满一簸箕，正准备起身端去火房煮。看到徐喜弟起来，她头也不抬，打了个招呼，“起来了，给你留了粥。”“今天……你就不用去割猪菜了，这么多，够吃三天的。”范金花说完就端着簸箕去火房了，徐喜弟对着那堆猪菜挠了挠头。刘烨给割的？那个傻子，不仅要帮张家生孩子，现在就准备给张家做免费劳动力了！想到刘烨，徐喜弟脸上就开始不自在。他确实厉害，而且还很会！折腾到半夜，没完没了的，看来一脸盆的饭没白吃。范金花就不怕借到一个饭桶傻儿子？不管了，即便是饭桶儿子，让张家和刘烨一起养，反正她是要走的。今天不用割猪菜，又不用伺候张永福，那干点什么好？巴儿姐呢？起来就没听到她的动静，又出去溜达了？徐喜弟心里一紧，有了昨天的事，她现在只要想到巴儿姐到处溜达，就很不放心。光棍太多了，一颗糖就能哄她趴草丛，那些人只怕没少动心思。李二拐那个狗东西，都差点得手了。“妈，巴儿姐呢？”徐喜弟匆匆进了火房，问范金花。“出去了吧，吃了早饭就不见人了。”范金花正在煮猪食，也没太当回事，语气也稀松平常。“妈，有些话我还是跟您直接说吧。”徐喜弟见范金花毫不关心的样子，皱起眉头，严肃说道。“怎么了？”范金花看她板起脸色，这才稍稍重视了一些，生怕她提昨晚的事，闹委屈。“巴儿姐都二十六了，她脑子再不灵光，身体也发育成熟了。您就没有疑惑，为什么她艿子长那么大吗？”“昂？”范金花往灶里递柴的手一顿，“为什么？她从小自由自在，肩不挑手不提的，长得粗一点有什么可奇怪的？”徐喜弟一噎，范金花的那点花花肠子，怕是全使自己身上了吧？对自己的女儿竟心大到这个地步。“妈，昨天李二拐给了巴儿姐一颗糖，然后就把她带山上去，让我给撞见了。家里再不重视，等出了事，可就晚了。”徐喜弟也没脸皮把昨天撞见的细节说太明白。范金花一脸懵，很快又变得十分诧异，最后转为无奈。“家里这么多活计，巴儿姐那个性子，谁又能顾得上……”这话像在喃喃自语。徐喜弟没想到话说到这份上，范金花还能这般云淡风轻，不敢置信地看着她。意思除一口饭养着，别的都不管了？那怎么行？徐喜弟甩手就出了门。昨天李二拐没得手，今天会不会故技重施？她最先去的地方，就是李二拐家，但是院门从外面扣上了，明显家里没人。那就去溪边看看，村里的姑娘婶婶们常去洗衣服的地方，巴儿姐经常去那儿，让人哄着帮洗衣服。转身一个抬头，就看到邻居家门口站着一个人，目光灼灼。“宇宁哥？”徐喜弟很意外，不太确定眼前的人，是不是她从小就认识的刘宇宁。因为他从小就爱上家里跟张永福玩，他让张永福管他叫哥，她也跟着这么叫。后来他出去读书了，听说一毕业就去当了兵，已经六年没见到人了，这会儿怎么在家？回来探亲？看他一身精神打扮，还真的大变样，高大又帅气，让人不敢认。“嗯。”他应了一声，然后脸就唰地红了。“你什么时候回来的？变化真大啊！”徐喜弟朝他走过去，噔噔噔就上了台阶，站在他跟前。徐喜弟仰头打量着眼前巨变的人，一脸的不可思议，“宇宁哥，当了兵的人气质就是不一样啊！还回部队吗？”刘宇宁不好意思地抓抓后脑勺，脸更红了。“我转业了，才回来两天。”“呀，转业是不去部队的意思吗？将来怎么打算？”当了兵，总不能还回来种地吧？后面的话，徐喜弟没好意思问。但两人从前关系熟得跟一家人似的，她什么都想问一问，聊一聊。“不去部队了，回来在镇上工作。”刘宇宁也如实地回答她，红通通的脸经过几句家常，也逐渐恢复如常。“在镇上工作，那是当官了呀！”徐喜弟瞪圆了双眼，一脸羡慕，同时也替他高兴。“还是你们读书有出路，你父母很快就能跟着你享福了。”“这次回来待多久？去上班了还能常回来吗？”一连串的话，让刘宇宁不知道怎么回，就只挑了最后两句回答。“不待多久，过几天就去报到。逢年过节应该有假期可以回来……”“就要去上班了啊，那你这几天有空，来家里找永福玩呀，几年不见，他可想你呢。”徐喜弟还跟从前一样，热情地邀请他上家里玩。“好……”刘宇宁的视线，一直放在徐喜弟的脸上，看着她高兴，他心里也高兴。“宇宁，你爸让去后院帮忙搭个梯。”王秀菊从后院匆匆走出来，脸色不太好看。明显是不太欢迎徐喜弟，连声招呼都不跟她打，不由分说就把刘宇宁拉走了。嘶……徐喜弟尴尬站在大门口，呲着牙离开。王秀菊从前就反对刘宇宁和她玩。现在儿子出息了，这会儿更不待见她了！得，她还得找巴儿姐呢，光跟刘宇宁聊得高兴，差点忘记正事。……刘宇宁被拉到后院，看到父亲已经踩着梯子上屋顶换瓦了。“爸，还是让我来吧。”他连忙爬上去换人。“宇宁啊，你以后，别跟张家那几个孩子来往了。”王秀菊黑着一张脸，仰头交代。刘宇宁不说话。不来往？怎么能不来往？“听见没？”王秀菊又说了一句。刘宇宁还是沉默不回应。王秀菊着急了，刘德怀一下来，就抓着他的手臂，“要不，还是让宇宁明天赶紧去镇上报到吧？”
content_en: Xu Xidi got up late again.My body isn't that sore, it's just that I slept too soundly.Fan Jinhua didn't call her, and was chopping pork and vegetables in the main room.Pig dish!Xu Xidi immediately sat up in shock, she was going to cut pig vegetables!It's almost noon, and the sun is already heating up outside.After getting dressed and hurried out of the room, I saw a large basket of pig vegetables in the corner of the main room, and a full sack next to it, which was about to explode after being squeezed hard.Fan Jinhua had already chopped a dustpan full and was about to get up and take it to the fire room to cook.Seeing Xu Xidi getting up, she said hello without raising her head, "I'm up, I've left some porridge for you." "Today... you don't have to cut the pig vegetables. There are so many, enough to last three days." After Fan Jinhua finished speaking, she carried the dustpan to the fire room. Xu Xidi scratched his head at the pile of pig vegetables.Did Liu Ye cut it?That fool not only wants to help the Zhang family give birth to children, but is now preparing to work as a free labor force for the Zhang family!Thinking of Liu Ye, Xu Xidi began to feel uncomfortable on his face.He is indeed great and very good at it!I worked on it until midnight, endlessly, and it seemed that all the food was not in vain.Isn't Fan Jinhua afraid of borrowing a stupid son who is a loser?No matter, even if the son is a loser, let the Zhang family and Liu Ye raise him together, she has to leave anyway.You don't have to cut pigs and vegetables today, and you don't have to wait on Zhang Yongfu, so what should you do?Where is Sister Baer?I didn't hear her movement when I got up, and went out for a walk again?Xu Xidi's heart tightened. After what happened yesterday, she now felt very uneasy just thinking about Sister Ba'er wandering around.There are too many bachelors, and a piece of candy can coax her to lie down in the grass. I'm afraid those people are too thoughtful.That bitch Li Erguai almost succeeded."Mom, where is Sister Ba'er?" Xu Xidi hurried into the fire room and asked Fan Jinhua."Let's go out. No one will be seen after breakfast." Fan Jinhua was cooking pig food, but she didn't take it seriously and her tone was normal."Mom, I'd better tell you some things directly." Seeing Fan Jinhua's unconcerned look, Xu Xidi frowned and said seriously."What's wrong?" Fan Jinhua saw her serious expression, and then she paid more attention to it, for fear that she would be aggrieved by mentioning what happened last night."Sister Ba'er is already twenty-six years old. She has no brains and her body has matured. Don't you have any doubts about why her pussy is so big?" "Ang?" Fan Jinhua paused as she handed the firewood to the stove. "Why? She has been free since she was a child. She has never carried her shoulders or hands. Is it strange that she is thicker?"He is so caring about his own daughter."Mom, yesterday Li Erguai gave Sister Ba'er a candy, and then took her up the mountain, where I bumped into her. If the family doesn't pay attention to her, it will be too late when something happens." Xu Xidi didn't have the shame to explain the details of yesterday's bump in.Fan Jinhua looked confused, then quickly became very surprised, and finally turned helpless."With so much work at home, who can take care of Sister Ba'er's temperament..." These words were like murmuring to himself.Xu Xidi didn't expect that Fan Jinhua could be so calm and calm at this point, looking at her in disbelief.Do you mean to care about nothing but food?How can that work?Xu Xidi waved his hand and walked out the door.Li Erguai failed yesterday, will he try his old trick again today?The first place she went to was Li Erguai's house, but the courtyard door was locked from the outside, and it was obvious that no one was home.Then go to the stream and see where the girls and aunts in the village often go to wash clothes. Sister Baer often goes there and is coaxed to help with the washing.Turning around and looking up, he saw a man standing at the door of his neighbor's house, his eyes burning."Brother Yuning?" Xu Xidi was surprised, not sure if the person in front of her was Liu Yuning, whom she had known since childhood.Because he had fallen in love with playing with Zhang Yongfu at home since he was a child, he asked Zhang Yongfu to call him brother, and she also called him brother.Later, he went out to study. I heard that he joined the army as soon as he graduated. He hadn't seen anyone in six years. Why was he at home now?Coming back to visit relatives?Looking at him dressed up in spirit, he has really changed a lot. He is tall and handsome, making people dare not recognize him."Yeah." He responded, and then his face turned red."When did you come back? What a big change!" Xu Xidi walked towards him, then climbed up the steps and stood in front of him.Xu Xidi raised his head and looked at the drastically changed person in front of him, with a look of disbelief on his face, "Brother Yuning, the temperament of a soldier is different! Do you want to return to the army?" Liu Yuning scratched the back of his head in embarrassment, and his face became even redder."I changed my job and have only been back for two days." "Yeah, does changing my job mean I won't join the army? What are my plans for the future?" After becoming a soldier, I can't go back to farming, right?Xu Xidi was embarrassed to ask about the rest.But the two of them had known each other as if they were a family, and she wanted to ask and talk about everything."I won't go to the army anymore. I'll come back and work in the town." Liu Yuning answered her truthfully, and his red face gradually returned to normal after a few ordinary words."Working in the town means becoming an official!" Xu Xidi's eyes widened with envy on his face, and he was also happy for him."You still have a future in your studies, and your parents will be able to enjoy the blessings with you soon." "How long will you stay here this time? Can you come back often after going to work?" Liu Yuning didn't know what to say after a series of words, so he only chose the last two sentences to answer."I won't stay long, I'll report in in a few days. I should be able to come back during the holidays..." "I have to go to work. If you have free time these days, come and play with Yongfu at home. We haven't seen you in a few years. He misses you." Xu Xidi warmly invited him to play at home as before."Okay..." Liu Yuning kept his gaze on Xu Xidi's face. Seeing her happy, he was also happy in his heart."Yuning, your dad asked you to go to the backyard to help build a ladder." Wang Xiuju hurried out of the backyard, her face not looking good.It was obvious that Xu Xidi was not very welcome. He didn't even say hello to her and pulled Liu Yuning away without any explanation.Hiss...Xu Xidi stood awkwardly at the gate, bared his teeth and left.Wang Xiuju had objected to Liu Yuning playing with her in the past.Now that her son has become successful, he doesn’t want to see her anymore!Yes, she still had to find Sister Ba'er. She was so happy chatting with Liu Yuning that she almost forgot about the real thing....Liu Yuning was pulled to the backyard and saw his father already stepping on the ladder to replace the tiles on the roof."Dad, let me do it." He quickly climbed up and replaced him."Yuning, please don't associate with those children of the Zhang family from now on." Wang Xiuju said with a dark face and raised her head.Liu Yuning said nothing.No contact?How can we not interact with each other?"Did you hear that?" Wang Xiuju said again.Liu Yuning remained silent and did not respond.Wang Xiuju was anxious, and Liu Dehuai grabbed his arm as soon as he came down, "How about asking Yu Ning to report to town quickly tomorrow?"
